mechanism_narrative: Accelerating GDP growth, as measured by the year-over-year change in real GDP, signals a strengthening economy that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Y-o-y GDPC1 growth accelerates by > 2pp but SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in the unemployment rate below 4% signals a tightening labor market that will drive wage inflation, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as the Fed tightens policy.
failure_condition: UNRATE drops below 4% but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A large monthly decline in industrial production signals a supply shock that will negatively impact economic growth and S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO declines > 0.5% m-o-m but SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in > 50% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the housing starts series is rising and the federal funds rate is below 2%, this combination signals a housing-led economic expansion that will boost S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST rising and FEDFUNDS < 2% but SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A rapid rise in the consumer price index above 3% signals an inflation scare that will drive the Fed to tighten policy aggressively, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL rises > 3% y-o-y but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in > 50% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When payroll employment growth is accelerating and the unemployment rate is falling, this combination signals a tightening labor market that will drive wage inflation and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: PAYEMS growth accelerating and UNRATE falling but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: Real estate investment, as measured by the RSAFS series, leads economic cycles and signals future demand strength. A sharp rise in RSAFS will predict positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: RSAFS rises > 2% m-o-m but SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in > 50% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production is falling and real estate investment is rising, this divergence signals a supply-driven slowdown that will negatively impact S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO falling and RSAFS rising but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.
